title: Riding Rules Notice: Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Vehicles, Concurrent Unlocks and Scooter Limits
content:
Fleet riding rules for the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plans: which vehicle types a plan may unlock, how many vehicles one rider may have unlocked at the same time, how a group of vehicles is charged, the scooter age and curfew limits, and the unpaid-charge condition on e-bike unlocks.

## Rules by plan

| Plan | Vehicle types the plan may unlock | Vehicles one rider may have unlocked at the same time | Charging of several unlocked vehicles | Minimum rider age for scooters (years) | Hours scooters cannot be unlocked (market local time) | E-bike unlock requires no unpaid charges on the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | classic bike, e-bike, scooter | 1 | each vehicle is its own ride | 18 | 23:00 to 05:00 | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | classic bike, e-bike, scooter | 1 | each vehicle is its own ride | 18 | 23:00 to 05:00 | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | classic bike, e-bike, scooter | 1 | each vehicle is its own ride | 18 | 23:00 to 05:00 | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | classic bike, e-bike, scooter | 1 | each vehicle is its own ride | 18 | 23:00 to 05:00 | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | classic bike, e-bike, scooter | 2 | each vehicle is its own ride | 18 | 23:00 to 05:00 | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | classic bike, e-bike, scooter | 2 | each vehicle is its own ride | 18 | 23:00 to 05:00 | Yes |

## The rules in words

- Every plan may unlock classic bikes, e-bikes and scooters.
- The Annual and Annual Plus plans allow 2 vehicles unlocked at the same time; every other plan allows 1.
- Each unlocked vehicle is charged as its own ride under the rider's plan.
- Scooters are for riders aged 18 or over, and cannot be unlocked between 23:00 and 05:00, market local time.
- On every plan, an e-bike unlock requires that the plan have no unpaid charges.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical riders)

- A Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus rider unlocks two classic bikes at once, one for a companion: that is within the limit of 2, and two rides are charged under the rider's plan, one per vehicle.
- A Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass rider already riding one vehicle is at that plan's limit of 1.
- A rider aged 17 cannot ride a scooter under any plan; a rider aged 18 meets the scooter age.
- A scooter unlock at 23:30 or at 04:30 market local time falls inside the curfew; at 22:30 or at 05:30 the curfew does not apply.
- A Wayfare Bikes Day Pass rider with an unpaid charge on the plan does not meet the condition for an e-bike unlock.
